ohtani.title: Shohei Ohtani crushes 30th homer to fuel Dodgers’ win
ohtani.blurb: Shohei Ohtani crushes his 30th home run of the year and Freedie Freeman drives in two to fuel the Dodgers’ 7-6 win over the Rockies

imanaga.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits two homers in Cubs' win
imanaga.blurb: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits a walk-off and leadoff homer, and Shota Imanaga strikes out 10 in the Cubs' 7-5 win over the White Sox

suzuki.title: Alex Bregman delivers walk-off in Cubs' 4-3 win
suzuki.blurb: Alex Bregman drives in one run, capped by his 9th-inning walk-off hit to give the Cubs a 4-3 victory over the White Sox

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Kazuma Okamoto sets Blue Jays rookie HR record in win
okamoto.blurb: Kazuma Okamoto sets a Blue Jays rookie home run record and Alejandro Kirk drives in three runs in Toronto's 10-5 win over the Rays

murakami.title: Alex Bregman delivers walk-off in Cubs' 4-3 win
murakami.blurb: Alex Bregman drives in one run, capped by his 9th-inning walk-off hit to give the Cubs a 4-3 victory over the White Sox

matsui.title: Casey Mize throws six scoreless frames in Padres' win
matsui.blurb: Casey Mize throws six scoreless frames, and the Padres rack up four solo home runs in their 5-0 win over the Guardians
